sentences.text:
This petition is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 7 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., seeking to quash the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.341/2024 pending on the file of II-Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Raichur, arising out Crime No.73/2023 registered by Raichur Women Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act (for short, hereinafter referred to as 'the D.P.Act').
2.

entities.text: II-Addl. Senior Civil Judge & JMFC, Raichur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Respondent No.2 served and unrepresented.

3. The case of the prosecution is that on the complaint of respondent No.2-Sumangala, who filed NC: 2024:KHC-K:5868 complaint to the police on 11.09.2023 alleging that she has married to accused No.1 and there was family dispute between the parties the matter went up to Lok-Adalath in the Family Court where accused No.1 undertake to pay Rs.3.00 lakhs towards permanent alimony and sought for divorce, but she has not agreed for the same, hence, case was adjourned.

Subsequently, the accused persons are all joined together formed unlawful assembly on 09.09.2023 they are assaulted the complainant, her mother and family members and caused injuries and they have also demanded dowry of 5 crores of gold, Rs.15.00 cash, silver articles, car etc., for the accused No.1 otherwise they will commit murder and the same was questioned by the brother of the complainant, then accused No.1 said to be assaulted with knife and caused injuries; he abused him in filthy language.
Hence, prayed for taking the action.
After registering the FIR the police investigated the matter and filed charge-sheet, which is under challenge.

The learned counsel for the petitioners has seriously contended that this case subsequent complaint based upon the same allegations as respondent already filed a complaint with the same police in Crime No.14/2021 and police have investigated the matter and filed charge-sheet against three accused i.e. petitioner Nos.1, 2 and another person Shekamma.

The petitioners are approached this Court in Criminal Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. and this Court vide judgment dated 27.01.2022 quashed the criminal proceedings against accused Nos.2 and 3 and against accused No.1 was dismissed.
The said offences are 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, which is still pending before the same Court on the very same complaint by the same complainant before the same police.

Therefore, this complaint is a second complaint on the same cause of action i.e.
improved version and she has not stated about the earlier complaint and charge-sheet filed by the police.
Therefore, this is second case for same offence is nothing NC: 2024:KHC-K:5868 but abuse of process of law.
Hence, prayed for quashing the same.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned High Court Government Pleader objected the petition contending that there was 2 to 3 injured persons, there was quarrel between them and accused persons assaulted the complainant and the family members.
Therefore, there is a case triable by the Magistrate.

Hence,
prayed for dismissal of petition.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, I have perused the records, especially the complaint made by the respondent No.2 to the police on 11.09.2023.

On perusal of the entire compliant she has stated that there was family dispute and they undertake to compromise, the accused ready to give permanent alimony of Rs.3.00 lakhs and she has not agreed of divorce etc., and the accused persons assaulted and harassed her physically and mentally pertaining to demand of dowry.

On careful reading of complaint nowhere she has stated that she has already filed complaint to the police which is registered NC: 2024:KHC-K:5868 with Crime No.14/2021 and where the accused Nos.2 and 3 were already got quashed the charge-sheet and it is not the case of the complainant that accused were attached them for withdrawing the said complaint is as good as a fresh complaint filed by respondent No.2 by suppressing earlier compliant and charge-sheet filed against the husband and others.

Even though this Court quashed the criminal proceedings against accused Nos.2 and 3 in the said Crime No.14/2021 CC No.5326/2021 the very case cause of action for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC pending against accused No.1 the present petitioner No.1 herein, which appears respondent No.2 though not challenged the earlier petition filed by the petitioners and criminal proceedings pending against the accused she suppressed the material fact and filed a fresh complaint on the same cause of action and police also by ignoring the pendency of the earlier case and charge-sheet filed for the offence punishable under Section 498A and other offences also and police also blindly filed charge-sheet against the NC:
2024:KHC-K:5868 petitioners for the similar offences, which is nothing but abuse of process of law and liable to be set aside.
7. It is a clear case where respondent No.2 suffered a set back in the earlier case where accused got quashed the criminal proceedings and now she has included all the family members i.e. first petitioner's brothers, their wives, and wives mother as accused, which is nothing but after thought to false implicate to treat them as accused.
When such being the case, I am of the view that criminal proceedings liable to be quashed.
8. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
The criminal proceedings against accused Nos.1 to 7 is hereby quashed.

Sd/-
(K NATARAJAN) JUDGE SDU CT:SI Manjunath G And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143920280/
